data: Microsoft's operating income was about $88.5 billion in fiscal 2023 (ending June 30, 2023) and about $128.5 billion in fiscal 2025 (ending June 30, 2025), an increase of roughly 45.2%. I'm working from memory rather than a filing I checked here, so please confirm these figures against Microsoft's fiscal 2025 Form 10-K before relying on them.
